items.title: Learn Why The Bull Case For ConocoPhillips Stock Could Change Following Earnings And Dividend Hike
items.summary: ConocoPhillips reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$20.1b and net income of US$4.0b, alongside an 11% lift in its regular quarterly dividend to US$0.93 per share. The mix of higher earnings, steady production from key Lower 48 assets, and a larger cash return commitment signals management confidence in the underlying cash generation profile.
